keeps.name: Bond Falls West Campground
keeps.waterfront_evidence: Down from the sweep's lakefront. NAIP 0.27-0.4 m/px: pads under pine canopy on the peninsula above the dam, none legible at the water; visible clearings and the loop road ~50-100 m from the shore and DEM 460-470 m against a 444 m pool, matching reviewers' 'path leading down to the lake' (W18, 2023) and 'site up the hill from the water' (20). Views are firsthand: W21 'a lake view', 11-12 'good views of the lake' (2022). 'Maybe 10 sites on the water' (2020) and 'right on the lake' (site 19) tie to no pad I could see, and a reviewer's phrase alone can't earn on-water. --Claude
keeps.inclusion_evidence: UPPCO's release of 2026-07-20 names Bond Falls West Campground as traditional campground-style sites by the reservoir, free and first-come; posted site board (Campendium photo) numbers W-1 onward. Drive-in RV stays reported: 34 ft fifth wheel at W18 (Oct 2023) and W5/W6 (Aug 2022), 30 ft trailer at W-5 (Jul 2022), travel trailers at W6 (Sep 2024) and 21 (Oct 2026). No posted length limit found. Google 4.9 (11). --Claude
keeps.note: Upper Peninsula Power Company campground in the pines on the Bond Falls Flowage's southwest peninsula, about 1.5 km south of the dam. From Paulding take Bond Falls Rd about 3 miles and follow the brown-and-yellow signs for the West Shore boat access and campsites on a packed-sand road; a 2024 reviewer warns not to follow Google or RV Life for the last mile. Pick an open site; a host comes round about 11am with the required permit. Site sizes vary. UPPCO posts no length limit: a reviewer fit a 34-ft fifth wheel in Oct 2023, calling the loop a little tight, while another found tight turns and scraping branches at site 10 with a travel trailer in Sep 2023. --Claude

sites.note: UPPCO: 48 rustic sites across West and East, no split published. The posted board runs W-1 onward with W-24 and W-25 walk-in and W-26 marked camps; reviewers and signs give the drive-in loop as 1-22 or 1-23. Pull-through: W5, 21 (reviewers). Each has a picnic table and fire ring.

facilities.note: Hand-pump water at points around the campground, not at each site. Its own public boat launch.

booking.note: UPPCO: 'Reservations: None. All campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis.' Maximum stay is 14 nights PER YEAR. Holiday weekends often reach capacity. Free permit required; valid ID.

sites.source: UPPCO release 2026-07-20 (total only); posted board (Campendium photo); Campendium and RV Life reviews for pull-through sites

hookups.source: UPPCO release 2026-07-20 (no electric hookups, hand-pump water); RV Life stay records 2023-2026 (power 0, no water or sewer at the site)

fees.source: UPPCO release 2026-07-20; posted board 'There is no fee for camping'

adds.name: Bond Falls East Campground
adds.waterfront_evidence: E14 motorhome, Jul 2025 (RV Life): 'right on the water. Large site with level parking', sunny and open. Google photos, sites 9 and 11 (2022): table and fire ring on grass running to a sand beach ~15-25 m away, no road between. NAIP 0.27 m/px: a white unit ~25 m from the bay at 46.4020,-89.0823 on its own spur off the main road, which runs ~115 m inland here. Above the dam, DEM 447 against a 444 m pool. Not every site: the pin is the spread's centre, and only these pads are seen or tied to the shore. --Claude
adds.inclusion_evidence: UPPCO's release of 2026-07-20 names Bond Falls East Campground as more dispersed sites, free and first-come; posted site board (Campendium photo) numbers E-12 to E-17 and an overflow area. Motorhome stayed at E14, Jul 2025 (RV Life, recorded as space for a longer RV and tow, interior roads navigable). No posted length limit found. Google 4.5 (8). --Claude
adds.note: Upper Peninsula Power Company's dispersed sites strung along the northeast shore of the Bond Falls Flowage, on the far side from the West loop. On Bond Falls Rd, about 3.5 km east of the falls, turn south at the Calderwood Rd junction; a dirt road follows the shore for about a kilometre, with spurs to the sites. Pick an open site; a host comes round about 11am with the required permit. A 2025 reviewer checked for open sites on the clipboard at the small building near the Outpost. UPPCO posts no length limit and no reviewer gives a rig length here; a motorhome used E14 in Jul 2025. Spurs under canopy are unmeasured. --Claude

sites.note: Dispersed, numbered E- on the posted board (at least to E-17), with overflow by E15-E16. Count not stated apart from UPPCO's 48 for both areas: see West. Each has a picnic table and fire ring.

facilities.note: Hand-pump water at points around the campground, not at each site. Its own public boat launch.
